value.rationale: A naturally occurring one-parent height-one DAG class has explicit concentrated frequency for every fixed component type, giving a complete first-order zero–one law whose almost-sure theory has FMP yet fails ω-categoricity. Not merely the classical total idempotent enumeration or an arbitrary finite slice.
